name: Chuck McAuley
biography: Chuck McAuley is a principal security researcher with the Application & Threat Intelligence Research Center (ATIRC) at Keysight Technologies. Chuck has a variety of interests that include 5G and LTE packet core vulnerabilities, reverse engineering botnets, finding novel forms of denial of service, and researching weird esoteric protocols for weaknesses and vulnerabilities
